claude_proposed_widenings.name: Attachment.kind = item
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item's bonus-action form change uses the existing v4 alter_item_kind effect, but the current surface cannot attach an activation to the weapon itself. Self/target/area/mark would misattach the change to the bearer instead of the quarterstaff.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: While holding this weapon, you can take a Bonus Action to alter its form, turning it into a 6-inch rod ... or a 10-foot pole, or reverting it a Quarterstaff.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: EquipmentPredicate.kind = item_form
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Several mechanics are gated by the weapon's current form, not just by holding it. The current passive/reaction condition grammar can express holding_item, but not 'only while this item is in quarterstaff form' or 'quarterstaff and 10-foot pole forms only.'
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Acrobatic Assist (Quarterstaff and 10-Foot Pole Forms Only). ... Attack Deflection (Quarterstaff Form Only). ... Ranged Weapon (Quarterstaff Form Only).

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ReactionTrigger.kind = after_rolling_initiative
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The light-toggle timing includes a non-action trigger window that fires after the bearer rolls Initiative. The current non-spell reaction trigger grammar has no initiative-based trigger.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: While holding this weapon, you can cause it to emit green Dim Light out to 10 feet, either as a Bonus Action or after you roll Initiative...
